title: Join a Club
subtitle: 考点：社团 / 一般过去时 / 乐器
passage: Our school has many clubs. There are the drama club, the music club, the art club and the hiking club. Last week, I chose the drama club because I like to act out stories.
My friend Lucy joined the music club. She plays the violin. Her brother plays the drum, but he is in the hiking club. He thinks nature is more fun than music.
vocab: club 俱乐部 · join 参加 · choose 选择 · drama 戏剧 · act out 表演 · violin 小提琴 · drum 鼓 · musical instrument 乐器

questions.stem: Which club did the writer choose?
questions.why: Last week, I chose the drama club.

questions.stem: Why did the writer choose it?
options: The writer likes to act out stories.
questions.why: because I like to act out stories

questions.stem: Which club is Lucy's brother in?
questions.why: he is in the hiking club
